question: Is it possible to convert a cloze-style questions to a naturally-looking questions?
title: Simple and Effective Semi-Supervised Question Answering
answer_rationale: The retrieved documents discuss the generation and use of cloze-style questions for pre-training QA models, their performance, and characteristics, but none address the possibility of converting cloze-style questions into naturally-looking questions.
